text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Noticing something wrong with Duramente's 
running during training, you take her to 
the hospital. The diagnosis reveals an 
issue with her bones.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Told that domestic races would be fine, 
but an overseas expedition with drastic 
environmental changes carried risk. In 
other words, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
was...

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Should we pursue the dream, or give it up? 
...I wavered. After much agonizing, we 
decided to forgo the overseas expedition. 
Duramente agreed that we should focus on 
domestic races.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
—It's frustrating. If only I had the 
skill... Maybe I wouldn't have had to give 
up on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. ...I 
can't go on like this.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
So, the Trainer decided to seek guidance 
from the family. Absorbing their knowledge 
and techniques, they would ensure she ran 
the Kikuka Sho in peak condition, no 
matter what!
